1: // Minimal endless runner for canvas with id "game"
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return;
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 200;
8: 
9:   // player definition
10:   const player = {
11:     x: 50,
12:     y: H - 30,
13:     w: 20,
14:     h: 30,
15:     vy: 0,
16:     jumpStrength: -8,
17:     gravity: 0.4,
18:     onGround: true,
19:     sliding: false,
20:     slideHeight: 15,
21:   };
22: 
23:   const obstacles = [];
24:   let speed = 2;
25:   let frame = 0;
26:   let score = 0;
27:   let gameOver = false;
28: 
29:   // Input handling
30:   const onJump = () => {
31:     if (player.onGround && !player.sliding) {
32:       player.vy = player.jumpStrength;
33:       player.onGround = false;
34:     }
35:   };
36:   const onSlide = (down) => {
37:     if (down && player.onGround && !player.sliding) {
38:       player.sliding = true;
39:       player.h = player.slideHeight;
40:       player.y = H - player.h;
41:     } else if (!down && player.sliding) {
42:       player.sliding = false;
43:       player.h = 30;
44:       player.y = H - player.h;
45:     }
46:   };
47:   document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
48:     if (e.code === 'Space' || e.code === 'ArrowUp') onJump();
49:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') onSlide(true);
50:   });
51:   document.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
52:     if (e.code === 'ArrowDown') onSlide(false);
53:   });
54:   canvas.addEventListener('click', onJump);
55: 
56:   // obstacle generator
57:   function addObstacle() {
58:     const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'gap';
59:     const w = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
60:     const h = type === 'spike' ? 20 + Math.random() * 20 : 0; // gap handled by y=H
61:     const ob = {
62:       x: W,
63:       y: H - h,
64:       w,
65:       h,
66:       type,
67:     };
68:     obstacles.push(ob);
69:   }
70: 
71:   function update() {
72:     if (gameOver) return;
73: 
74:     // player physics
75:     player.vy += player.gravity;
76:     player.y += player.vy;
77:     if (player.y + player.h >= H) {
78:       player.y = H - player.h;
79:       player.vy = 0;
80:       player.onGround = true;
81:     }
82: 
83:     // obstacles movement
84:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
85:       const o = obstacles[i];
86:       o.x -= speed;
87:       // remove off-screen
88:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
89:     }
90:     // spawn
91:     if (frame % 100 === 0) addObstacle();
92: 
93:     // collision detection (AABB)
94:     for (const o of obstacles) {
95:       if (o.type === 'gap') continue; // gap handled by falling
96:       if (
97:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
98:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
99:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
100:         player.y + player.h > o.y
101:       ) {
102:         gameOver = true;
103:       }
104:     }
105:     // gap check (if player is over a gap area)
106:     for (const o of obstacles) {
107:       if (o.type !== 'gap') continue;
108:       if (player.x + player.w > o.x && player.x < o.x + o.w) {
109:         // player is over gap
110:         if (player.y + player.h >= H) {
111:           gameOver = true;
112:         }
113:       }
114:     }
115: 
116:     score++;
117:     frame++;
118:     if (frame % 500 === 0) speed += 0.5; // gradual speed increase
119:   }
120: 
121:   function draw() {
122:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
123:     // ground line
124:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
125:     ctx.fillRect(0, H - 5, W, 5);
126: 
127:     // player
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f';
129:     ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.w, player.h);
130: 
131:     // obstacles
132:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
133:     for (const o of obstacles) {
134:       if (o.type === 'gap') continue;
135:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
136:     }
137: 
138:     // score
139:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
140:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
141:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score / 60), 10, 20);
142: 
143:     if (gameOver) {
144:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
145:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
146:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
147:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
148:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
149:     }
150:   }
151: 
152:   function loop() {
153:     update();
154:     draw();
155:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
156:   }
157: 
158:   loop();
159: })();
